hunches.label: Hunches
hunches.description: The idea queue: ideas waiting to be explored, one file each with its status (template: ds/standard/hunch.md, rules: ds/standard/queue.md). A researcher's new idea lands here for another researcher to pick up.

methods.label: Methods
methods.description: One card per idea being explored (template: ds/standard/method-card.md): its registered test, baseline, results, decisions and evaluation.

decisions.label: Decisions
decisions.description: Digests of decisions made on the floor that the user should know about, written by the decisions role.

stories.label: Stories
stories.description: Slide decks and write-ups telling what the research team is doing, written by the storyteller.
